You'll work on both frontend and backend features, integrate authentication with Keycloak, and prepare apps for deployment in Kubernetes. Responsibilities Frontend Development • Build responsive UIs using React + TailwindCSS. • Implement new features and improve existing components for internal apps. Ensure good UX and cross-browser compatibility. • Backend Development • Develop APIs with Node.js + Express. • Integrate with PostgreSQL for data storage and queries. Write secure, well-documented REST endpoints. • Authentication & Security • Integrate apps with Keycloak for login, roles, and session handling. Manage JWT tokens and middleware for frontend & backend communication. • Deployment Readiness • Containerize apps for Kubernetes deployment. • Write environment config files, docs, and setup guides. Support staging to production deployments with CI/CD pipelines. • Eligibility Eligible applicants must be: • Enrolled or graduated from electrical engineering, software engineering, computer science, or a closely related program. Eligible to work in Canada. • Job Requirements Requirements Must-Have Skills • React + TailwindCSS (frontend). • Node.js + Express (backend). • PostgreSQL basics (schemas, queries). • Authentication/OIDC concepts (Keycloak preferred). Git/GitHub workflows. • Nice-to-Have • Docker & Kubernetes basics. Experience with REST API security best practices. • Familiarity with building reusable boilerplate/templates. • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Application Link: TTG Talent Acquisition Please include your resume and transcript, and with your GPA clearly labelled.
